verdict.rationale: The docs show the core document-processing products (Parse, Extract, Classify, Split, Index) offered through the REST API, SDKs, CLI and MCP alongside the Web UI, and saved configurations can be reused by ID. However, no source claims full API/UI parity, and account, organization and RBAC management through the API is never shown. Missing for 10: explicit statement of full UI/API parity, API coverage of admin/org/SSO/RBAC and project management, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
